# Released voice-answer request fixture

`question/answer/023` executes the previous release's tokenless answer construction, capability gate, response classification, 15-second timeout, lease classification, and timeout warning. `gh release list --limit 3` identified `v0.49.2` as latest on 2026-10-29. Sources were read with `git show v0.49.2:<path>` from this repository's history. `provenance.json` records each copied source range (inclusive, one-based) and its SHA-256, plus the hashes of the compiled fixture files. The test verifies those file hashes before opening its fence.

`client.rs` wraps the copied methods and expressions with test transport plumbing: a local Unix socket, frame exchange, an admitted follow-on Hello, and a request-observation buffer. Its capability read uses the shared client's public Hello API. It does not call the current answer sender or current desktop timeout/wording code. `lease.rs` is the released lease implementation before its test module, unchanged. The outer fixture supplies a known valid question and selection; this is a pin on the released send/timeout contract, not a complete released desktop build, voice resolver, IPC admission, remote transport or incarnation-negotiation test. Those limits matter to the rule-12 evidence.

The copied spans stay unformatted under the test module's `rustfmt::skip`. To update this fixture deliberately, copy from a named release in git history, retain source ranges and hashes, update the compiled hashes, and explain the new compatibility baseline. An edit to today's desktop does not update this fixture.
